name: Juniper-Marinated Venison Loin with Braised Red Cabbage (Captain's Gala Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
whyItWorks: Venison tenderloin is ultra-lean red meat with almost zero saturated fat; the risk comes only from the braised red cabbage side.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the venison loin medium-rare with mashed potatoes instead of the fibrous braised red cabbage, and brush off crushed juniper berries.
watchOuts: Fibrous braised red cabbage side (swap for potatoes)
